subject.title: fix(agents): retry same profile before timeout auth rotation

question: Should OpenClaw accept one same-model/profile retry for ordinary assistant timeouts before auth-profile rotation or model fallback?
rationale: The implementation appears correct, but it intentionally changes fallback timing and auth-profile health semantics for existing setups, which is a maintainer policy choice rather than an automated repair decision.

options.title: Accept Bounded Timeout Retry
options.body: Merge this policy after refreshing the head because it avoids spending auth-profile rotation on the first ordinary timeout while preserving fast failover for auth, billing, quota, and rate-limit failures.

options.title: Keep Immediate Failover
options.body: Reject or revise the PR so ordinary assistant timeouts keep spending the existing rotation/fallback lane immediately.

options.title: Request Narrower Policy
options.body: Ask for a different product shape, such as limiting the retry to a narrower failure class, before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept Bounded Timeout Retry
recommendation.body: Merge this policy after refreshing the head because it avoids spending auth-profile rotation on the first ordinary timeout while preserving fast failover for auth, billing, quota, and rate-limit failures.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the broadest recent adjacent agent runtime/session history among the routing candidates and is best positioned to decide the compatibility-sensitive policy tradeoff.
